name: session-pulse
description: Keeps long unattended Claude Code sessions alive: next wake-up and usage on the status line, automatic wake-ups, back-to-back idle counting, a usage-limit pause that wakes after the reset, and self-compaction.

heartbeatMinutes.title: Longest wake-up (minutes)
heartbeatMinutes.description: Wake-ups longer than this are shortened to it, and Claude is told to keep one set while work is pending (1 to 60).

idleLimit.title: Idle wake-ups before stopping
idleLimit.description: After this many idle wake-ups back to back, Claude writes its handoff notes, compacts and stops (1 to 10).

capWakeups.title: Shorten long wake-ups
capWakeups.description: Shorten a wake-up longer than the longest wake-up.

autoWake.title: Set wake-ups automatically
autoWake.description: When a turn ends with the heartbeat on and no wake-up set, session-pulse sets one of the longest wake-up itself, so a session with work never falls asleep. Idle counting still stops it.

autoStart.title: Start the heartbeat on your first message
autoStart.description: Turn the heartbeat on as soon as you write, instead of when Claude first sets a wake-up. Each wake reads the session again, so this costs usage in sessions that are just chat.

remindOnStop.title: Remind Claude to keep a wake-up set
remindOnStop.description: Only with automatic wake-ups off: when a turn ends with the heartbeat on and no wake-up set, ask Claude once to set one or stop the heartbeat.

usageLimitPercent.title: Usage limit (percent)
usageLimitPercent.description: When the 5-hour or weekly window reaches this, Claude is told once to save its notes and stop (and to compact if the reset is far away); session-pulse wakes the session after the reset (50 to 100).

resetNearMinutes.title: Reset counts as near within (minutes)
resetNearMinutes.description: A reset closer than this: Claude saves and waits without compacting. Further away: Claude also compacts (0 to 600).

resumeMinutes.title: Wake after the reset (minutes)
resumeMinutes.description: How long after a usage window resets session-pulse wakes the session (0 to 60).

rules.title: Add the heartbeat rules to Claude's instructions
rules.description: Adds a short section to the system prompt explaining the wake-up and idle rules.
